title: Kit Command Scope Refactor
description: Refactor semio/rs, semio/graphql, semio/js, semio/react, semio/sketchpad so every kit mutation is scoped: kit or alternative latest checkpoint -> draft -> transaction -> command batch. Add KitWriteScope in Rust, typed GraphQL command inputs (no JSON scalars for writes), JS KitStore scoped APIs, React scope providers/hooks, Sketchpad routing through scoped commands. Bind plan kit_command_scopes_b02844b8.
summary: Rust: removed unscoped live kit mutations (ChangeKitCommands, ChangeKitWithInverse, Design) from LiveBatchCommandInput; only WIP undo/redo remain on live. Regenerated schema.graphql. JS: KitStore tracks session/draft/transaction anchors, buildSessionScopedTopLevelCommand + runScopedTransactionBatch for all kit/design writes and submitChangeKitCommands; undo/redo use live batch; fixed vcsState query brace, read queries for metadata/coloredConnectors, TypeStore metadata null coercion; WasmKitStoreClient exposes get/set KitWriteScope + finalize/abort transaction. React: optional kitWriteScope on KitScope, re-export KitWriteScope, test stubs updated. Engine schema test asserts kitStore.batch. Storybook semioWasm uses kitStore.batch. Rebuilt semio/rs/pkg with wasm-pack.
